title: Anna's Profile
objective_es: Identificar nombre, vivienda, trabajo y horarios.
grammar_es: I am = soy/estoy; I live = vivo; at introduce una hora.
body: My name is Anna. I am 28 years old. I live in a small flat in Porto. I work as a shop assistant. I start work at nine. I finish at five. In the evening, I cook dinner with my brother. On Saturdays, we visit our mother. On Sundays, I rest and read books.

title: Leo's Day
objective_es: Leer una rutina y reconocer he.
grammar_es: He retoma el nombre de un hombre; after significa después de.
body: Leo gets up at six thirty every day. He drinks water and eats bread with jam. He walks to the bus stop at seven. He works in an office from eight to four. He eats lunch at noon. After work, he plays football with friends. At night, he watches the news and goes to bed at ten.

Evidencia: “He works in an office from eight to four.”

Evidencia: “Leo gets up at six thirty every day.”

title: Green Market Notice
objective_es: Encontrar horarios y ubicaciones en un aviso.
grammar_es: Open = abierto; closed = cerrado; near = cerca de.
body: Green Market Shop Notice. We are open Monday to Friday. Hours are nine to six. On Saturday, we are open from ten to two. We are closed on Sunday. Milk and bread are near the door. Fruit is in the middle. Please pay at the back. Thank you for your visit.

questions.explanation_es: Evidencia: “We are closed on Sunday.”
Evidencia: “Fruit is in the middle.”
Evidencia: “Please pay at the back.”
Evidencia: “On Saturday, we are open from ten to two.”

title: Way to the Library
objective_es: Seguir indicaciones y referencias con it.
grammar_es: Los verbos Walk y Turn al inicio dan instrucciones. It puede retomar un lugar.
body: To go to the library, start at the bus station. Walk straight on Park Street. Pass the bank and the school. Turn left on Flower Road. The library is next to the park. It is opposite the hospital. It is open every morning. Ask at the desk for help.

title: Sara's Birthday Party
objective_es: Localizar fecha, hora, dirección e instrucciones en una invitación.
grammar_es: Please introduce una petición; no indica negación. By Wednesday incluye el miércoles como fecha límite.
body: You are invited to a birthday party for Sara. It is on Friday at six in the evening. The party is at her house at 5 Lake Street. We have pizza, cake, and music. Please bring no gifts. Please call Sara at 555 214 by Wednesday. We hope to see you there.

title: A Day at the Museum
objective_es: Seguir una narración breve en pasado.
grammar_es: Visited, left y returned describen acciones pasadas; after y then ordenan eventos.
body: Last Saturday, our class visited the city museum. We left school at nine in the morning by bus. The guide showed us old clothes, tools, and photos. We learned how people lived one hundred years ago. After the visit, we ate sandwiches in the garden. Then we drew our favourite object. We returned to school at three in the afternoon. It was a sunny and quiet day. Everyone enjoyed the trip very much.

title: Weekend Visit Plan
objective_es: Entender planes, referencias y una causa explícita en un correo.
grammar_es: Can propone posibilidades; will expresa aquí intención; because introduce la razón.
body: Hi Marta, Thanks for your email. I can visit you next weekend. My train arrives on Friday at seven in the evening. On Saturday morning, we can walk in the old town and visit the market. In the afternoon, we can cook together. On Sunday, I need to leave at four because I work on Monday. Please tell me if this plan is good for you. I will bring dessert. See you soon. Love, Elena

title: City Flat and Village House
objective_es: Comparar dos lugares y comprender causas con so.
grammar_es: Bigger significa más grande; but contrasta; so introduce una consecuencia.
body: I live in two places during the year. My city flat is small but very quiet. It is near my work, so I walk to work every day. My village house is bigger and has a garden. It is far from shops, so I need the car. Life in the city is fast and busy. Life in the village is slow and calm. I like the city in winter and the village in summer because the weather is better there.

questions.explanation_es: Evidencia: “My city flat is small but very quiet.”
Evidencia: “My village house is bigger and has a garden.”

questions.explanation_es: Evidencia: “I walk to work every day.”

title: Train Time Change
objective_es: Distinguir horario anterior, nuevo e instrucciones.
grammar_es: Will leave indica una salida futura; not contrasta con la hora anterior; same significa el mismo.
body: Dear passengers, your train to Lisbon on Sunday has a new time. It will leave at ten thirty, not at nine. Please arrive at the station at ten. Go to platform four with your same ticket. The trip will take two hours. The train will stop in two small towns. Free water is available in car three. We are sorry for this change. Thank you for your understanding. For help, visit the information desk near the main door.

Evidencia: “Go to platform four with your same ticket.”

title: How to Close the Shop
objective_es: Seguir una secuencia de trabajo y una condición.
grammar_es: First, next, then ordenan acciones. If introduce una condición; except señala una excepción.
body: To close the shop in the evening, follow these steps. First, turn off all the lights except the front one. Next, count the money and put it in the safe. Then, clean the tables and wash the cups. After that, lock the back door and close the windows. Write the day and sales in the red book. Finally, put the key in the blue box. If there is a problem, call Marco at 555 890. Thank you for your careful work.

title: A Community Garden
objective_es: Comprender un artículo sencillo y conectar causa y efecto.
grammar_es: Presente simple para actividades habituales; because explica razones; they retoma personas.
body: The community garden is behind the library. Six neighbours work there on Saturday mornings. They grow tomatoes, carrots, and flowers. Each person brings a tool, and everyone shares the work. They collect rainwater in large containers because summer days are often dry. New members can join by leaving their name at the library desk. In August, the group gives some vegetables to a local kitchen. The rest goes to the people who work in the garden.
